description: Huawei E3372h in the HiLink "Gateway NCM" stick mode (12d1:155a): NCM data and AT ports, so ModemManager owns it as a Huawei stick; the E3372 AT set (AT^HCSQ signal, AT^SYSCFGEX bands, AT^CHIPTEMP). Reference only, not on our bench. Sources: another modem manager 3.5.8 README (added from 4PDA reports) and modem/usb/12d1155a (the 12d1:1506 E3272/E3372/E3276 AT profile); docs/HANDOFF.md 126 (12d1:155a E3372h NCM, to the catalog)
